question: In whose shrines may the ritual alternatively be performed?
premises: The shrine of Vighnarāja is named.
The shrine of Śāstṛ is named.
The shrine of the Mothers is also named.
inference: The ritual may also be performed in the shrine of Vighnarāja, Śāstṛ, or the Mothers.
plain_english: Or also in the shrine of Vighnarāja, of Śāstṛ, or of the Mothers.
